odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's test of a Sunday activity pattern behind the change from 405 to 228 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F6] has no grounding in measurement timestamps, because Parking Servis publishes 621 values across 27 locations from 22 min ago without any measurement time [F5]. Observer's pairing with 230 values from 2 RHMZ automatic stations received 22 min ago [F28] likewise provides no alignment when the age of the parking data is unknown [F5], while SEPA reported 67 min ago with 1213 values across 32 locations without measurement time [F2] and Sensor.Community reported 17 min ago with 8213 values from 43 instruments in the last 6 h [F4]. Neither the 7 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade on skating at Pionir [F7], the 7 from Studio B [F9], the 43 from Danas [F8], nor the 26 from RTS [F15] can ground local activity hypotheses because their geographic scope is unconfirmed.
